name: primitives-headless-checkbox
blurb: Animated checkbox with Headless UI and Framer Motion with indeterminate support.
description: Checkbox primitive using Headless UI with Framer Motion animations. Supports checked and indeterminate states with path animations. Renders render function children.
use_when: Building custom checkbox designs with smooth animations and multi-state support.
avoid_when: When you need simple unstyled checkboxes without animation overhead.
a11y: Built on Headless UI checkbox primitive which provides full keyboard and screen reader support.
